text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Organized by me! Starring me! The lavish 
Dinner & Opera Show is officially 
underway! ...Yet perhaps this, too, is a 
twist of fate.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Around the same time, the generation one 
year above— the "Golden Generation"—was 
hosting an event.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Sure, they've got a track record of 
winning. ...However! The real star of the 
show is me!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
"Just you watch... With a performance 
truly worthy of the leading star, I shall 
open everyone's eyes!" Roused with such 
determination—she indulged in a banquet 
with her supporters.
